site.site_about: Market Call is Canada's leading stock market call-in program. Every weekday, top fund managers and market analysts, professionals who handle billions in retail and institutional investments, give their thoughts and top picks. We take your calls on everything from REITs to ETFs. Don't miss the action. Market Call is an investment that always pays off.
